lyrics.ti:
[[chorus]]
ኣልቦ ዘከማየ /2/ ኣበሳ ሓጢኣት ገባሪ
ወኣልቦ ዘከማከ /2/ እግዚአብሔር መሓሪ
[[/chorus]]

መድኃኔ ዓለም ክርስቶስ ዓለማተ ኵሉ ፈጣሪ
[[highlight]]በደመ ገቦከ /2/ ኃጢኣትየ ኣስተስሪ /2/[[/highlight]]

ከምዚ ከማይ የለን ከምዚ ከማይ
ኣበሳ ኃጢኣት ገባሪ
[[highlight]]ከማኻ'ውን የለን /2/ እግዚአብሔር መሓሪ[[/highlight]]

መድኃኔ ዓለም ክርስቶስ ናይዚ ዓለም ኵሉ ፈጣሪ
[[highlight]]ብደም ናይ ጎንኻ /2/ ኃጢኣት ኵሉ ኣስተስሪ[[/highlight]]
lyrics.ti_ro:
[[chorus]]
ʾAlbo zekemaye /2/ ʾabesa hat'iʾat gebari
Weʾalbo zekemake /2/ Egziabher mehari
[[/chorus]]

Medhane ʿalem Kristos ʿalemate kulu fet'ari
[[highlight]]Bedeme geboke /2/ hat'iʾatye ʾastesri /2/[[/highlight]]

Kemzi kemay yelen kemzi kemay
ʾAbesa hat'iʾat gebari
[[highlight]]Kemakha'win yelen /2/ Egziabher mehari[[/highlight]]

Medhane ʿalem Kristos nayzi ʿalem kulu fet'ari
[[highlight]]Bidem nay gonkha /2/ hat'iʾat kulu ʾastesri[[/highlight]]
